div.b: Deterministic priority (rules caregaps.priority/1, first match wins)
div.span:
1. Hereditary or family history pathway (BRCA, colorectal family history): high
2. Outcome is requires_clinical_review: high
3. Eligible, but sources conflict: elevated
4. Everything else: routine
A priority set on a guideline version is a floor and is never lowered. Priority orders the work. It never changes eligibility, and no model is involved.

div.span:
• Only caregaps.service changes status. Other modules call it and never edit status.
• A reason is required for escalated, cancelled and closed_not_completed.
• completed is reachable only through closure with verified completion evidence.
• Terminal cases can only be reopened, into pending_review.
• Permissions: caregaps.manage, caregaps.review and caregaps.close, depending on the change.
